description: Upload a text file to a router, overwriting any existing file of the same name. Prefers SFTP (encrypted, over SSH) and falls back to plaintext FTP if SFTP is unavailable. Requires SSH (or FTP) access for the router user. Dry-run tests connectivity only.

dryRun.description: Validate SFTP or FTP connectivity without writing the target file

name.description: Target filename on the router (e.g. flash/my-script.rsc)

routerId.description: Router ID; omit to use the default router.

name: upload_file
title: Upload File
